model_configurations.critical_note: These are the ONLY approved models for V1. Do NOT substitute.

model.name: red_agent
model.specialization: Security reasoning, code analysis, attack planning, vulnerability classification
model.why_this_model: Specialized in security reasoning, trained on vulnerability patterns

model.name: blue_agent
model.special_features: - Built-in chain-of-thought reasoning - Superior multi-step vulnerability remediation - Excellent test case generation
model.specialization: Secure code fix generation with step-by-step reasoning
model.why_this_model: Chain-of-thought reasoning critical for complex security fixes

model.name: support_agents
model.shared_by: - GOVERNANCE Agent (policy evaluation) - DOCUMENTATION Agent (Google Docs generation) - AUDIT Agent (compliance logging)
model.specialization: Microsoft-tuned for instruction following, deterministic outputs
model.why_this_model: Fast, consistent, excellent for structured decision-making and technical writing

recommended_hardware.dev_testing: 24GB RAM, M4 Pro or RTX 4060 Ti (16GB VRAM)
recommended_hardware.production: 32GB RAM, RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM) or A6000 (48GB VRAM)

principle.title: Context Files are Source of Truth
principle.description: ALL implementation decisions MUST reference context files. Never make assumptions.

principle.title: RED-BLUE Verification Loop
principle.description: BLUE generates fix → RED attacks fix with original PoC → Loop until verified
principle.v1_constraint: No auto-merge. All fixes create PR for human review

principle.title: 5-Layer Safety Gates
principle.description: ALL fixes must pass 5 safety gates before deployment consideration
principle.gates: 1. Input Validation 2. No New Vulnerabilities (Semgrep scan) 3. Backward Compatibility (100% test pass) 4. Performance (<10% overhead) 5. Test Coverage (>80%)

principle.title: Immutable Audit Trail
principle.description: Every action logged to immudb with cryptographic signatures

principle.title: Docker Sandboxing for All Generated Code
principle.description: NEVER execute generated code directly. Always use Docker with resource limits

phase.name: User Initiates Scan
phase.system_response: Validate URL, clone repo, create scan job

phase.name: RED Agent Discovery
phase.actions: Scan with Nuclei/Semgrep/Checkov/CodeQL, generate PoCs, classify by CWE/CVSS

phase.name: Documentation Agent Initial Report
phase.actions: Create Google Doc with findings via MCP

phase.name: Governance Agent Prioritization
phase.actions: Calculate risk scores, apply OPA policies, prioritize fixes

phase.name: BLUE Agent Fix Generation
phase.actions: Generate 3 fix options, validate safety gates, test in Docker sandbox

phase.name: RED Agent Verification Loop
phase.actions: Re-attack fixed code with original PoC, verify vulnerability is gone
phase.output: Verified fixes (or loop back to BLUE)
phase.critical: This is the key differentiator - proof that fixes work

phase.name: Audit Agent Logging
phase.actions: Log all events to immudb with digital signatures

phase.name: Documentation Agent Final Report
phase.actions: Update Google Doc with complete findings, fixes, and compliance evidence

phase.name: BLUE Agent Creates PR
phase.actions: Create GitHub branch, commit fixes, open PR with detailed description

phase.name: Human Review and Merge
phase.v1_requirement: 2x human code review minimum before merge
phase.actions: Human approves PR, merges to production

constraint.title: NO AUTO-MERGE IN V1
constraint.description: All fixes MUST create PR and require human approval
constraint.rationale: V1 is MVP. Safety first. Humans must review every change

constraint.title: RED Verification Required
constraint.description: Every fix MUST be verified by re-attacking with original PoC

constraint.title: Google Docs via MCP
constraint.description: DOCUMENTATION Agent MUST use Google Workspace MCP for report generation
constraint.authentication: OAuth 2.0 service account from AWS Secrets Manager

constraint.title: Model-to-Agent Mapping
constraint.description: Each agent MUST use its designated model. No substitutions

orchestration.purpose: Multi-agent workflow orchestration with state management

development_workflow.step: Read ALL context files in ./context/ folder
Test verification loop thoroughly (RED → BLUE → RED cycle)
Validate all 5 safety gates pass before considering fix valid

architecture_reference.frequency: When designing new features or integrations

success_criteria.criterion: All implementations reference and comply with context files
RED-BLUE verification loop works (PoC fails after fix = proof)
All 5 safety gates implemented and enforced
Every action logged to immudb with signatures
All fixes create PR (no auto-merge in V1)
DOCUMENTATION Agent generates live Google Docs
Correct models loaded for each agent (WhiteRabbitNeo, DeepSeek-R1, Phi-3.5)

escalation_protocol.action: STOP immediately and review context files
HALT development, escalate to security lead
Loop back to BLUE Agent (max 10 iterations, then escalate to human)
